scripts.infra:reset: docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm infra:up
scripts.infra:openwa: docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.openwa.yml --profile openwa up -d --build openwa
scripts.infra:nango: docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.nango.yml --profile nango up -d nango-db nango-server
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm infra:up && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/wait-for-postgres.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:reset: pnpm --filter @platform/core-api reset && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
